hoplite.lede: A 32 second concept film for Hoplite, a tool for building with swarms of cloud agents. It follows one request from a single typed sentence to a finished landing page.

shots.title: The request
shots.text: One sentence typed into the prompt box sets up the whole film.
shots.alt: The prompt box with the request typed in

shots.title: The work
shots.text: Three agents take a part each and run side by side.
shots.alt: Three subagents listed with their tasks, one expanded to show its steps

shots.title: The line
shots.text: The product's promise in six words, held long enough to read.
shots.alt: The closing line: Build with swarms of cloud agents

hoplite.made: I rebuilt Hoplite's interface so every part could move, then animated each shot myself. It took about a month alongside school, and I rebuilt screens several times as Hoplite shipped updates. The sound is effects only, with no music.
hoplite.realAlt: A screenshot of the real Hoplite app, October 2026
hoplite.rebuildAlt: My rebuild of the whole Hoplite app, a frame from the film at 0:00:23:14

bridgemind.lede: A 30 second concept film for BridgeMind. One request, typed and then finished by voice through BridgeVoice, puts a lead agent in BridgeSpace to work with five more.

shots.title: The voice
shots.text: BridgeVoice takes over from the keyboard and finishes the request by speaking.
shots.alt: The BridgeVoice badge over the Cleo pane

shots.title: The request
shots.text: One sentence asks the lead agent to coordinate five more, from plan to release.
shots.alt: The finished request in the Cleo pane

shots.title: The line
shots.text: All six agents at work under the film's promise, held long enough to read.
shots.alt: The BridgeSpace workspace with six agents and the line From one prompt to coordinated work

bridgemind.made: I rebuilt the BridgeSpace and BridgeVoice interface as it was in August 2026 and animated each shot myself in After Effects. The film was made square for the feed, with a second 9:16 cut for stories.
